cell_line.evidence: To generate sufficient E. coli cells for lysis, an E. coli K12 MG1655 [M. S. Guyer strain, purchased from the DSMZ (Germany), DSM No.: 18039] colony was picked from Luria‐Miller (LB) broth agar‐plates (4‐g LB‐Agar‐Mix, 100‐mL deionized water) and transferred into 20‐mL LB medium (2.5 g per 100‐mL deionized water).
